notes.title: Pro Tip: Animals are Sticky. ;)
notes.content: Have you ever dreamed of not just placing a GIF but making it move around on the island? Well you are in luck. Just put a GIF onto of a crab or the bird at watch it move!

notes.title: New Fixes Patch Available
notes.content:
Hey there! We heard you loud and clear and got to work. We also really appreciate everyone reporting their issues with the tutorial. We have also added support for Oculus Rift via the Steam store. Please let us know if you still see issues! 

Happy GIF slinging,

-GIPHY
